name: Propylthiouracil (PTU)
mechanism: Inhibits thyroid peroxidase and peripheral conversion of T4 to T3
dosing: Thyroid storm: high-dose per endocrinology guidance; regular dosing individualized
pregnancy: Preferred in first trimester as alternative to carbimazole in some cases; specialist advice
clinicalPearls: Use specialist guidance for thyroid storm and pregnancy
